candidates.issues: Boil-then-fry method works. Only 3 tbsp water and 3 tbsp soy for 1 kg of potatoes gives a thin glaze that may not coat them all.
Coherent Korean-style braise with every ingredient used and clear doneness cues. 500 g is a modest batch.
Thorough braise-and-glaze method with good troubleshooting tips. Rice vinegar and scallions are added extras. The ingredient line "2 scallions Scallions" is redundant.
Smashing the potatoes departs from the round 'bolinhas' style the comment praises. Otherwise workable, though 1 liter of water may barely cover 800 g of potatoes.
Oven-roasted honey glaze departs from the skillet caramelization. Raw garlic and honey roasted for 25 minutes at 220°C risk burning. Adds ginger.
Solid braise. Using both sugar and honey is slightly redundant, and medium-high reduction risks scorching without a warning.
